Installation\n```bash\nnpm install multiagent-task-manager\n```\n\n## 🎯 Quick Start\n\n### Programmatic Usage\n\n```javascript\nconst TaskManager = require('./task-manager.js');\n\n// Initialize\nconst tm = new TaskManager({ dataDir: './my-project-data' });\n\n// Add agents\ntm.addAgent({\n  id: 'ai-dev-1',\n  name: 'AI Developer',\n  type: 'ai',\n  capabilities: ['coding', 'testing', 'documentation']\n});\n\ntm.addAgent({\n  id: 'john.doe',\n  name: 'John Doe',\n  type: 'human',\n  capabilities: ['all']\n});\n\n// Create tasks\nconst task = tm.createTask({\n  title:
